metadata.title: Constraints on the abundance of $0.01\,c$ stellar engines in the Milky Way

notes: No eligible stars. S5-HVS1, HVS 22, and Gaia DR2 6097052289696317952 are mentioned at T:p5-b5 only as high-speed/hypervelocity literature benchmarks; the paper does not explicitly state that they are unbound from the Milky Way or analyze/retain them as Galactic unbound candidates, and the Gaia object is merely called a “candidate.” HVS 3 is mentioned at T:p5-b3 only as an extragalactic-origin example traced to the Large Magellanic Cloud, not as a Galactic unbound candidate.
